description: Scores a placement test started with start_placement_test. Pass the test_id and the answers in question order (letters A to D). Scoring happens on the SpeakBase server; returns a CEFR level (A1 to C1), a 0 to 100 score and a link to the free spoken level test, which measures speaking.

answers.description: One answer per question, in order, for example ["B","A","C", ...].

native_language.description: The learner's own language as a two-letter code (for example he, es, ar). Used for explanations and for the language of the SpeakBase page the links open in.

name: score_placement_test
title: Score the placement test
